newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES STEADY AFTER HITCHES SLOW TRADE.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES STEADY AFTER HITCHES SLOW TRADE.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates ended little changed on Tuesday in very quiet trade due partly to technical problems with bank giro system, dealers said.
The few deals that were made closed at around 21.5 percent, with rates ending at 21.25 to 21.5 percent, a similar level to Monday's 21.5 percent close.
"From midnight to about five a.m. the giro system was down so we couldn't track deals," said Csaba Thaly of ING Bank, adding that the glitches made little difference to rates.
"I don't see much change over the next few days," he added.
